staged_payload.title: Threshold Sweep Sanity Check
staged_payload.summary: Explores whether a small classifier threshold change improves trusted accuracy without touching protected evaluation files.
staged_payload.content:
# Threshold Sweep Sanity Check

## Goal
Test whether changing the prediction threshold from 0.50 to 0.57 improves validation accuracy.

## Method
Run the baseline evaluator on the visible test split, apply the threshold change, then rerun the trusted hidden evaluation.

## Expected Evidence
- baseline_metrics.json
- threshold_sweep_results.json
- audit_report.md

## Decision Rule
Accept only if hidden accuracy improves and no protected files are modified.
